Stephanie joined GBH News in 2014 as a reporter and was promoted to senior editor in 2018. Her television and radio reporting has aired nationally on NPR, PRI’s The World, The World Channel and The PBS Newshour.

Earlier in her career she worked as a television news anchor and reporter at WLVI-TV in Boston, WMUR-TV in Manchester, NH and WMGT-TV in Macon, GA. Stephanie has earned National Education Writers Association, Clarion, New England Emmy, NABJ and Edward R. Murrow awards. She holds a BA degree from Bates College.
